description: Atom-typing archive extending the Foyer 1.2.0 OPLS-AA SMARTS rules: SMARTS definitions, precedence, and borrowed OPLS-AA types for chemistry the rules do not type. opls2020_types: SMARTS-conditioned refinement of the rule set's GROMACS-numbered types into OPLS/2020 type numbers (first matching rule per type; an empty SMARTS is that type's default; "from": "*" rules match by SMARTS alone, also untyped atoms). Classes and LJ come from the OPLS/2020 table.

Vinyl ether / enol C (C=C-OR, C=C-OH), with or without H and in rings (warfarin 4-hydroxycoumarin C4). Foyer 1.2.0's own definition [C;X3;!r6]([O;X2])([C;X3;!r6])([H]) is the special case it replaces.

Naphthalene ring-fusion C, but not an alkene C (opls_141/142) unless the six-carbon ring rule opls_145 also matches: bridged/fused cycloalkenes (norbornene, steroid C=C, guaiazulene) are alkene CM. Foyer 1.2.0's [C;R2;X3]([C,%opls_263])([C;R2;X3]) collided with 141/142 there; atoms 145 also matches (quinoid dyes) keep 147 as before.

Cl- ion only. Foyer's [Cl] gave the chloride-ion type (sigma 4.02 A, eps 0.71 kcal/mol) to every covalent Cl no narrower rule matched (vinyl, acyl, heteroaryl, CCl4, Cl on N/S/P/Si); those now take the halogen rules of opls2020_types, else GAFF2 LJ.
